t0337: 1140508 (ROC) Basic Life Support and Emergency Wound Care | Kaohsiung SmartAction Growth Association
t0338: 1140508 (ROC) Basic Life Support and Emergency Wound Care
t0339: When an unexpected accident happens, do you know what truly saves a life? According to statistics, thousands of people with out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (OHCA) face life-threatening danger every year; first aid within the crucial four minutes is their only hope of survival. This lecture, “Basic Life Support and Emergency Wound Care,” will help you learn practical CPR+AED skills, from theory to hands-on practice, so you can become a crucial lifesaver at the scene! Whether a family member collapses, someone loses consciousness on the street, or an emergency occurs in daily life, learning the correct response can save a precious life. The lecture is free, places are limited, and this is a valuable opportunity. Register now to provide greater protection for yourself and those you love!

t0383: 1140823 (ROC) Sleep Disorders in People with Parkinson’s Disease | Kaohsiung SmartAction Growth Association
t0384: 1140823 (ROC) Sleep Disorders in People with Parkinson’s Disease
t0385: Did you know? More than 70% of people with Parkinson’s disease have trouble sleeping well or deeply! From difficulty falling asleep, waking at night, and daytime drowsiness to common rapid-eye-movement sleep disorders, these problems cause fatigue and can also affect the illness and quality of life. This lecture examines common sleep disorders in Parkinson’s disease in depth, explaining their underlying causes and possible responses. People with Parkinson’s and their families are invited to join us to find better ways to improve sleep and daily energy, so sleeping well no longer feels difficult!
